episodes.name: UpWard
episodes.overview: Lady Upturn introduces Squidward, and his musical "talents," to her high society friends after she becomes his patron.

episodes.name: Unidentified Flailing Octopus
episodes.overview: Squidward sets out to prove that aliens aren't real... until he has a close encounter of his own.

episodes.name: Bad Luck Bob
episodes.overview: SpongeBob experiences a bad luck streak when his lucky tie clip suddenly goes missing.

episodes.name: The Sandman Cometh
episodes.overview: When Patrick can't fall asleep, he seeks assistance from the Sandman.

episodes.name: Biscuit Ballyhoo
episodes.overview: Sandy and the Science Scouts sell biscuits to fund a trip to Mars. When Mr. Krabs and his Krusty Scouts get in on the action, it turns into an all-out competition.

episodes.name: Student Driver Survivor
episodes.overview: When a competitor threatens to shut down Mrs. Puff's driving school, she must rely on SpongeBob to stay in business.

episodes.name: Wiener Takes All
episodes.overview: Tired of doing grunt work at the Krusty Krab, Squidward takes a new job as Manager of Weenie Hut Jr's.

episodes.name: Stuck in an Elevator
episodes.overview: When Squidward gets trapped in an elevator with SpongeBob and Patrick, he tries to escape in time to return a nearly overdue library book.

episodes.name: Squidness Protection
episodes.overview: Squidward's amazing new life in witness protection is threatened after SpongeBob and Patrick discover his whereabouts.

episodes.name: Dome Alone
episodes.overview: Sandy suspects Plankton's up to no good, so she recruits Patrick to investigate.

episodes.name: Wary Gary
episodes.overview: SpongeBob goes to extreme lengths to trick Gary into going to the vet.

episodes.name: Pinned
episodes.overview: SpongeBob accidentally gets pinned under his exercise equipment and must wait for help to arrive.

episodes.name: Jeffy T's Prankwell Emporium
episodes.overview: Squidward's prankster dad visits and brings all sorts of gags with him, much to Squidward's annoyance.

episodes.name: A Taste of Plankton
episodes.overview: Plankton tries to get a taste of the secret formula by attaching himself to SpongeBob's tongue.

episodes.name: Smartificial Intelligence
episodes.overview: Perch fights for his job after he's fired and replaced by a robot anchorman.

episodes.name: Firehouse Bob
episodes.overview: SpongeBob, Patrick, and Squidward feel the heat when they become volunteer firefighters.

episodes.name: Pablum Plankton
episodes.overview: Plankton wins a "cutest baby" contest and becomes the face of a baby food brand.

episodes.name: MuseBob ModelPants
episodes.overview: When Squidward's one-off portrait of SpongeBob takes the art world by storm, he has no choice but to produce more.

episodes.name: Delivery of Doom
episodes.overview: SpongeBob is challenged by E.V.I.L. to make a delivery to their secret lair in 10 minutes or less.

episodes.name: My Father the Boat
episodes.overview: When Mr. Krabs gets trapped inside of Pearl's new boat, he must pretend to be its engine to avoid being caught.

episodes.name: Who's Afraid of Mr. Snippers?
episodes.overview: Squidward and Plankton come together to make their very own stage play... and SpongeBob is casted as the villain!

episodes.name: A Fish Called Sandy
episodes.overview: Sandy decides to finally give herself gills so she can truly experience Bikini Bottom, but they come with a strange side effect.

episodes.name: Making Waves
episodes.overview: Mr. Krabs and Plankton must learn to get along after ending up shipwrecked on an island.

episodes.name: Captain Quasar: The Next Iteration
episodes.overview: SpongeBob and Squidina try to start their very own Captain Quasar fan club after being kicked out of Bubble Bass's.

name: Season 15
overview: Nautical nonsense continues to bubble up in Bikini Bottom! Find out why Mrs. Puff must rely on SpongeBob to keep her boating school in business. Watch Squidward enjoy his amazing new life in the witness protection program until SpongeBob and Patrick discover his whereabouts. See SpongeBob go to great extremes to trick Gary into going to the vet ― and Plankton attempts to get a taste of the Krabby Patty secret formula. Then, E.V.I.L. challenges SpongeBob to make a delivery to their secret lair in ten minutes or less!
